events.summary: Hey everyone,The time has been set.4:AM launches on December 10.To mark the announcement, we’ve released a new release date trailer offering a closer look at Aila’s escape through a world consumed by The Yellow.In 4:AM, survival means staying unseen, reading the world around you, and using whatever you can find to create a way forward. events.title: 4:AM is Coming to Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hey everyone,We’re excited to announce that 4:AM will be part of Steam Next Fest this October, with a new playable demo going live on October 15th.Set in a brutal near-future dystopia consumed by The Yellow, 4:AM follows Aila, a survivor on the run after escaping years of experimentation inside a hostile facility.In the demo, you’ll get an early look at 4:AM’s mix of cinematic tension, stealth, open-ended puzzle solving, and oppressive industrial worldbuilding. events.title: 4:AM - A Cinematic Stealth Puzzle Game, Coming 2026
events.summary: As the 4:AM team this is our first announcement, but it won't be the last. We've started sharing more recently and plan to keep it up.4:AM is a cinematic stealth puzzle game.
